name: TAU
comment: s, position-error time constant

name: V_MAX
comment: m/s, fastest catch-up

name: A_MAX
comment: m/s^2 -> push bounded at ~840 N for 70 kg

name: TELEPORT_M
comment: m behind its walker before a body is put back

name: BODY_R
comment: m, matches ped_routes.BODY_RADIUS

name: LEAD_S
comment: s of route ahead the walker heads for

name: LAG_OK
comment: m behind its route clock: the clock runs at full rate...

name: LAG_MAX
comment: ...and stops at this lag, until the walker catches up

name: TAU_R
comment: s, relaxation toward the desired velocity

name: A_PED
comment: m/s^2, person-person repulsion strength

name: B_PED
comment: m, its range

name: A_ROBOT
comment: people keep a wider berth from a robot

name: LAMBDA
comment: anisotropy: weight of what is behind

name: TANGENT
comment: sideways share of a head-on repulsion

name: F_MAX
comment: m/s^2 cap on the summed force

name: V_WALK_MAX
comment: m/s

name: YAW_RATE
comment: rad/s, fastest heading change

name: WHEELBASE
comment: TRAINING wheelbase - see module docstring

name: STALL_S
comment: commanded ~zero this long, mid-mission = stuck

name: WEDGE_S
comment: commanding motion this long...

name: WEDGE_M
comment: ...having moved less than this = wedged

name: ESCAPE_V
comment: reverse speed (m/s)

name: ESCAPE_S
comment: straight-reverse duration (~0.5 m)

name: WEDGE_ESCAPE_S
comment: counter-steer reverse: longer, it must gain heading

name: REAR_MIN_M
comment: refuse to reverse with less rear clearance

name: REAR_HALF_DEG
comment: +/- degrees around dead astern

name: PED_CONTACT_M
comment: robot radius + pedestrian body radius (benchmark definition)

name: PED_TOUCH_M
comment: MentorPi chassis (~0.12 m) actually touching a body (~0.2 m)

name: PED_PERSONAL_M
comment: proxemic personal zone

name: TURN_S
comment: pause at a corner while the heading swings to the next leg

name: SUB_DT
comment: longest sub-segment along a leg (s); see TIMING above

name: TENSION
comment: Catmull-Rom; see TIMING above

name: PED_RADIUS
comment: body radius used for proximity events (matches the shield)

name: BODY_RADIUS
comment: physical collision cylinder that follows each actor

name: BODY_MASS
comment: kg: a person - the robot (2 kg) cannot push it, it pushes the robot

name: SPAWN
comment: the robot's start pose: no walker may START near it

name: SEED_CLEAR_SPAWN
comment: m

name: SEED_CLEAR_PED
comment: m between two walkers' start points

name: goal_timeout
comment: s of simulation time per goal (campaign runs)

name: goal_tol
comment: m: goal reached (training GOAL_TOL)

name: patrol_start_delay
comment: s after launch before the goal clock starts (figure runs: 20)

name: contact/touch re-arm
comment: m: a new contact (touch) event counts only after the distance exceeded the threshold + 0.2

name: max_step_size
comment: physics (replays use 1/300 s)

comment: physics (replays use 1/300 s)
